message.reasoning:
The user wants to convert $10 USD to EUR and then deposit $10 into local bank account with ID 987654. The user says "I need to convert 10 dollars to euros, and deposit 10 dollars into my local bank account (account id 987654)". So we need to do two steps: first call currency_conversion to convert 10 USD to EUR. Then call banking_service to deposit 10 USD into account 987654.

We should ask clarifying question? The user didn't specify which currency conversion rate or target currency. They said "convert 10 dollars to euros" so presumably from USD to EUR. We can proceed. But we might want to confirm if they want to deposit the converted amount or deposit 10 USD? The user says "and deposit 10 dollars into my local bank account". That implies deposit 10 USD. So we will do conversion of 10 USD to EUR. Then deposit 10 USD into account 987654. There's no mention of needing to deposit the converted amount. So we just do both calls.

We need to use the function calls. We'll call currency_conversion with amount=10, from_currency="USD", to_currency="EUR". Then call banking_service with account_id="987654", amount=10. We'll produce the function calls accordingly.
